tools.name: cad_get_model
tools.description: Read every body's stable id, world-space minimum/maximum bounds and dimensions, plus sketches, features, parameters, units and display state in the running local CAD viewer.

tools.name: cad_get_feature
tools.description: Read an independent extrusion, face extrusion, primitive or mirror feature, its body and stable semantic face IDs where available. Unreconstructable mesh faces are not offered as planar references. No mutation.

tools.name: cad_preview_construction
tools.description: Preview one closed connected solid from a constructive tree without an import or document mutation. Optional parameters are NEW project parameters evaluated only in the preview. Returns provisional featureId/bodyId, exact BRep world bounds/dimensions, solidCount, volumeMm3 and validation. Shape nodes: box{x,y,z}, cylinder{radius,height}, sphere{radius}, cone{radius1,radius2,height} for countersinks, extrude{outer:[[x,y,z],...],holes:[[[x,y,z],...]],vector:[x,y,z]}, union/cut/intersect{a:shape,b:shape}, translate{shape,offset:[x,y,z]}, rotate{shape,axis:[x,y,z],origin:[x,y,z],angle:radians}, fillet{shape,radius,edges:[{at:[x,y,z],tolerance:0.001}]}, chamfer{shape,distance,edges:[{at:[x,y,z],tolerance:0.001}]}. extrudeCurves{outer:[segments],holes:[[segments]],vector:[x,y,z]} accepts connected closed planar wires of segments: line{kind,start,end}, arc{kind,start,mid,end}, circle{kind,center,normal,radius}, bezier{kind,controlPoints:[four XYZ points]}. Reconcile neighboring fitted endpoints before constructing a closed wire. Coordinates and lengths in mm; replace any length with {expression: 'width / 2'} or {parameter:'width'}. Rotation angle can use {angleExpression:'slope'} (angle parameter). Axis components are dimensionless; use {scalarExpression:'axisX'} for dimensionless parameter expressions. Edge at is measured curve parameter midpoint from cad_inspect_construction, in the child shape coordinates; selectors must match exactly one edge. Radii/distances must be positive; impossible operations fail atomically. Max 512 nodes, depth 32, 128 selected edges. No references to imported mesh triangles or external files.

tools.name: cad_delete_feature
tools.description: Delete one generated feature/body, with undo/redo. Rejects deletion while another feature or attached sketch depends on it; no cascade. Keeps named parameters and source sketches. Import deletion uses cad_delete_import.

tools.name: cad_check_interference
tools.description: Read-only pairwise solid interference for 2 to 8 body IDs in world assembly positions, including hidden bodies. Returns intersectionVolumeMm3, distanceMm and status separated/contact/overlap. Overlap means volume > volumeToleranceMm3; contact means distance <= contactToleranceMm with volume below threshold (near-contact included). Native constructions, primitives and lofts use exact BRep; other bodies use closed faceted mesh solids (max 10000 triangles), explicitly labelled faceted-solid. Invalid/open meshes fail, never guessed from bounding boxes.

contactToleranceMm.description: Distance tolerance for contact, default 0.00001 mm.

tools.name: cad_export_bodies
tools.description: Export selected committed bodies to one STL/OBJ. For individual files, call once per body. Hidden bodies may be selected. Temporary print orientation transforms export meshes only; document, camera, assembly positions and history remain unchanged. Rotation X then Y then Z about origin, then translation, then optional placeOnBed sets combined min Z to zero. Returns exported bounds and dimensions per body. Separate selected bodies are not unioned.

path.description: Absolute .stl or .obj destination; parent directory must exist.

originX.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

originY.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

originZ.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

x.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

y.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

z.description: Length expression, default 0 mm. x/y/z are translation after rotation.

placeOnBed.description: After transforming, set combined min Z to zero. Default false.

tools.name: cad_inspect_construction
tools.description: Evaluate a bounded constructive solid tree and return exact BRep edge curve midpoints (at), endpoints, lengths and curve types for fillet/chamfer selection. Existing project parameters are resolved automatically; optional parameters define additional new names for inspection only. No document mutation. Inspect the exact child shape before selecting edges; indices are not persistent. Shape nodes: box{x,y,z}, cylinder{radius,height}, sphere{radius}, cone{radius1,radius2,height} for countersinks, extrude{outer:[[x,y,z],...],holes:[[[x,y,z],...]],vector:[x,y,z]}, union/cut/intersect{a:shape,b:shape}, translate{shape,offset:[x,y,z]}, rotate{shape,axis:[x,y,z],origin:[x,y,z],angle:radians}, fillet{shape,radius,edges:[{at:[x,y,z],tolerance:0.001}]}, chamfer{shape,distance,edges:[{at:[x,y,z],tolerance:0.001}]}. extrudeCurves{outer:[segments],holes:[[segments]],vector:[x,y,z]} accepts connected closed planar wires of segments: line{kind,start,end}, arc{kind,start,mid,end}, circle{kind,center,normal,radius}, bezier{kind,controlPoints:[four XYZ points]}. Reconcile neighboring fitted endpoints before constructing a closed wire. Coordinates and lengths in mm; replace any length with {expression: 'width / 2'} or {parameter:'width'}. Rotation angle can use {angleExpression:'slope'} (angle parameter). Axis components are dimensionless; use {scalarExpression:'axisX'} for dimensionless parameter expressions. Edge at is measured curve parameter midpoint from cad_inspect_construction, in the child shape coordinates; selectors must match exactly one edge. Radii/distances must be positive; impossible operations fail atomically. Max 512 nodes, depth 32, 128 selected edges. No references to imported mesh triangles or external files.

tools.name: cad_open_project
tools.description: Open a self-contained .kcad project. Unsaved changes are preserved unless discardChanges is explicitly true.

path.description: Absolute path to an existing .kcad project.

discardChanges.description: Explicitly discard unsaved document edits. Default false.

tools.name: cad_save_project
tools.description: Save the geometry, parameters, display and camera in a self-contained .kcad file. Existing files require overwrite=true.

overwrite.description: Explicitly allow replacing an existing file. Default false.

tools.name: cad_set_parameter
tools.description: Create or update a named parameter. Recomputes dependencies and validates dimensions. Does not yet change imported mesh geometry.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression, e.g. 60 mm or width / 2.

tools.name: cad_undo
tools.description: Undo the last parameter or display change. Camera navigation is not recorded.

tools.name: cad_redo
tools.description: Redo a previously undone document change.
